plan.title: Forward auction rejects duplicate vendor price

steps.note: Open the prepared live forward-auction vendor screen without creating or changing the event.
Sign in as Vendor B in the separate supplier portal while preserving the buyer session.
Open the live auction's pricing round for Vendor B.

args.need: enter Vendor A's exact existing bid price in Vendor B's bid form and submit the bid

steps.note: The vendor portal must not expose Vendor A's price, and the catalog cannot transfer that hidden value into the bid form.

args.text: A bid at this price already exists, please quote a different price.

steps.note: Verify that the duplicate-price submission is refused with the expected message.
